item: A-012 follow-up and 0.5.1 item 36: the reach ratchet follows imports, aliases, module-qualified calls and atexit/signal targets; the partial .eml import is a pinned stated limit
refs: PR #1509; audit 0.5.0 A-012 part 3 follow-up; follows PR #1507, R252; 0.5.1 item 36
summary: tests/test_loop_heads_reach.py resolves a call to ONE function through an import (from x import f, from x import f as _g, import x as m then m.f()) and treats a function given to atexit.register or signal.signal as an entry of its own, so a common name (start, end, digest) is no longer cut at the file edge when an import names it; it surfaced three scopes the by-name graph hid (expedition._memory, swap.swap_readings, vitals_history.start), all listed with reasons as script, dev-tool or event-loop (R165), and the wiki build_index collision rows now carry the entries the wider graph finds. The resolver is mutation-checked (cutting its edges fails the real-repo test and the planted ones). STILL NOT SEEN: a call through a decorator, a registry, getattr, a stored callable or an instance attribute; no cheap by-name proxy exists for those, so it stays a stated limit in the module docstring, not code. 0.5.1 item 36 is closed as a STATED LIMIT, not a change: tests/test_newsletter_import_partial.py pins that a failed later round leaves the earlier rounds stored, answers 500 naming the storage failure with no tally, and that a re-import stores only what is missing; a partial tally in the reply remains a decision for whoever edits those tests. Test and docs only; no src change.
